stage7_semantics: structural work estimate: physical work required by each QueryPlan, WritePlan, CandidateSpec and deployment, computed only from pre-benchmark evidence. NOT a latency or performance predictor.

logical_byte_policy.variable_width_rule: declared or pre-benchmark-estimated mean width per column, supplied by the scenario; UNKNOWN if absent (never zero)
logical_byte_policy.naming: logical_bytes_proxy / logical_storage_bytes_proxy (not disk, network or SSTable bytes)

route_choice_within_deployment: among valid plans whose tables are all in the deployment: lexicographic minimum of (read_cql_requests, read_logical_rows, read_logical_bytes, plan_id)

deployment_aggregation.read_axes: sum over read operations of frequency x per-execution work of the chosen route; frequencies normalised to sum 1 over reads
deployment_aggregation.write_axes: sum over write operations of frequency x work summed over the deployment tables the write must maintain
deployment_aggregation.risk: max_partition_bytes, max_partition_rows = max over tables; partition_count = sum

risk_axes_decision: risk axes are NOT dominance axes in V3: decided before measurement (D-V3-006) to keep the front non-degenerate and identical across benchmarks; they are reported and used as structural diversity / warnings
selection: if |Pareto| <= top_k keep the whole front; else greedy structural diversity over deployment tags, ties and ordering by balanced_structural_tiebreak
balanced_structural_tiebreak: mean over Pareto axes of value / min positive value of that axis among all complete deployments of the benchmark (equal weights); axes whose values are all zero are skipped. Used ONLY for ordering and tie-break, never named a prediction.
